references.text: Contrast between a deceptive identity (Gen 27:23) and an honest gift of reconciliation (Gen 32:14) in Jacob's life journey.
Parallel to the emotional reunion between brothers after a long-standing conflict.
The overnight stay serves as a narrative and theological turning point before a decisive reunion or mission.
Direct narrative connection: Preparation for the reunion (Gen 32:14) and the actual reunion itself (Gen 33:4).
